emails.subject: URGENT Follow-Up: Missing Causality Assessment - SAE Report for HV-004 - Study IPN-123
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Vance,

I hope this email finds you well.

This is an urgent follow-up regarding the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) report for subject HV-004 in Part A, submitted on November 3rd.

Upon review, we found that the causality assessment section on the form is incomplete. This information is critical and required for an upcoming safety report with a strict deadline.

Please find the submitted report attached for your reference. Could you please provide your assessment of the event's relationship to the investigational product at your earliest convenience?

Thank you for your prompt attention to this critical matter.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins
Clinical Research Associate
InnovatePharma

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Follow-Up: Missing Causality Assessment - SAE Report for HV-004 - Study IPN-123
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for flagging this. I have just spoken with Dr. Vance between patients, and she will review and respond shortly.

Best,

Mark Rivera
Clinical Research Coordinator
Oak Valley Clinical Research

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Follow-Up: Missing Causality Assessment - SAE Report for HV-004 - Study IPN-123
emails.body:
All,

My apologies for this oversight. Thank you for the prompt follow-up.

After reviewing the case, my assessment is that the SAE (acute kidney injury) is **possibly related** to the investigational product.

Mark, please update the source documentation and the official SAE form with this assessment and resubmit to the Sponsor today.

Regards,

Dr. Eleanor Vance
Principal Investigator
Oak Valley Clinical Research

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Follow-Up: Missing Causality Assessment - SAE Report for HV-004 - Study IPN-123
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Vance,

Thank you very much for your swift response and for providing the causality assessment. This is exactly what we needed.

We can now proceed with our safety reporting. We will look out for the updated form from Mark.

We appreciate your team's quick action on this.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins
Clinical Research Associate
InnovatePharma
